footer.tagline: ReLoop — no donation reaches a dead end.
footer.honesty: Recycling settlements are simulated and masses are estimates.

errors.unreachable: The server didn't answer. Check that the backend is running, then try again.

location.tapToPlace: Tap the map to drop a pin
location.pinned: Pin at {lat}, {lng} — drag it to adjust
location.geoFailed: Your browser couldn't share your location. Drop the pin by hand instead.

landing.subtitle: The jacket your child outgrew can keep another warm this winter. The books on your shelf can fill a classroom. ReLoop finds the people who need what you no longer use — and if no one can use it, sees that it's recycled, not binned.

trust.private: Address shared only after a yes

need.label: AI-powered matching
need.title: It goes where it's needed
need.text: Organisations are ranked by what they've actually asked for, how urgently, and how close they are — so your gift lands where it matters most.

deadEnd.label: Waste fallback
deadEnd.title: A “no” is never the end
deadEnd.text: If one place can't take it, the next best one is asked. If no one can, it's recycled — your donation still counts.

journey.label: Live tracking
journey.title: You see where it goes
journey.text: From the moment you list it to the moment it's received, every step is recorded and shown to you.

flow.title: A “no” is never the end.
flow.text: If an organisation can't take it, ReLoop asks the next best one. If nobody can use it, it's recovered, not binned.

textile.text: of textile waste is generated in India every year. 58% of it is post-consumer: the clothes households finish with.
textile.source: Ministry of Textiles, Mapping of Textile Waste Value Chain in India, 2026

postConsumer.text: of post-consumer textile waste is not diverted from landfill.

unaccounted.text: of India's municipal solid waste is unaccounted — neither processed nor landfilled.

list.title: Snap and list
list.text: Tell us what it is, add a photo, and drop a pin for pickup.

choose.title: Choose who receives it
choose.text: See the organisations that need it most, and why — then pick one.

handover.title: Hand it over
handover.text: They collect, or you drop it off. Then watch it reach its next home.

landing.orgTitle: Tell us what you need. We'll bring it to you.
landing.orgText: List what your organisation needs and how urgently. You'll receive offers that match — nearby, and yours to accept or decline. A donor's address is shared with you only once you accept.
landing.ctaTitle: Give your things a second life.
landing.ctaText: List your first donation in a few minutes. Someone nearby could use exactly what you're about to give away.

aside.title: No donation reaches a dead end.

list.title: Listed
list.text: People list the clothes, toys and books they no longer use.

match.title: Matched to need
match.text: Verified organisations are ranked by what they have asked for, with the reasons shown.

reroute.title: Re-routed, not dropped
reroute.text: If one organisation declines, the item goes to the next best fit.

recover.title: Reused or recovered
recover.text: What can't be reused is recycled, not binned.

aside.footer: Every step is recorded, so the outcome of each item is known.

auth.badCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.
auth.donorCardText: Clothes, toys or books in good shape. We'll find who needs them.
auth.orgCardText: NGOs, shelters, schools and homes: receive offers that match your needs.
auth.adminNote: Admin accounts are created by the platform operator, not here.
auth.donorSubtitle: You'll be able to list your first item straight away.
auth.donorPrivacy: Your pickup address is shown to an organisation only after it accepts your donation, and every release is recorded.
auth.orgSubtitle: One login per organisation. You'll receive offers once an admin verifies you.
auth.orgAccountNote: One login per organisation: the person who will answer offers.
auth.orgFixedNote: Name and registration ID can't be changed after registration.
auth.orgAcceptingNote: Donors are matched only with organisations that accept the category and have room for it. You can change this later.
auth.orgPickCategory: Choose at least one category to continue.
auth.orgLocationNote: Drop a pin where donations should go. The public map shows only your neighbourhood; a donor sees your address once you accept their donation.
auth.orgPendingNote: Your organisation starts as pending. An admin reviews it, and once you're verified you start receiving offers that match your needs. Meanwhile you can set up your needs list.

fields.storageCapacityHint: How many items you can hold at once — a count, not kilograms.
fields.pickupCapableHint: Turn on if you provide organisation pickup service.
fields.addressHint: As you'd write it for a visitor. The pin, not this text, sets the location.
fields.quantityHint: A count of items, e.g. 12 shirts.
fields.noteHint: Sizes, age range, anything that helps them decide.
fields.priorityHint: Moves your offer up in organisations' inboxes. It doesn't change who is ranked first.

donor.intro: Every item you list is followed until it is reused or recycled.
donor.emptyText: List clothes, toys or books, and ReLoop will rank the organisations that need them.

donation.awaitingAnswer: Waiting for {org} to answer — the offer expires {when}.
donation.photoFailed: Your donation was listed, but the photos weren't uploaded
donation.escalatedText: Choose what happens next with the buttons above.
donation.windowAdvisory: The pickup window is a preference shown to organisations, not a deadline.
donation.addressPrivacy: Only you can see this. An organisation sees it only after accepting, and each release is recorded.

holder.title: Who's receiving it
holder.dropoffOnly: They don't collect: please drop it off.
holder.privacy: Shared with you while this organisation holds your donation.

newDonation.title: List an item

conditionHelp.NEW: Unused, tags or packaging may be on.
conditionHelp.GENTLY_USED: Worn or read a little, no damage.

newDonation.whereTitle: Where should it be picked up?
newDonation.whereText: Drop a pin on the map. Organisations see only a rounded distance until one accepts.
newDonation.whenText: A preference shown to organisations; the exact time is agreed after acceptance.
newDonation.photosText: Organisations decide on condition, so a clear photo helps. Location data is removed on upload.
newDonation.nextHint: Next you'll see a ranked list of organisations, with the reasons behind each ranking.

sendToRecycling.title: Send an item to recycling
sendToRecycling.intro: This item will not be offered to any organisation: it goes straight to recycling.
sendToRecycling.whenText: When it can be collected for recycling.
sendToRecycling.confirmTitle: This item will not be offered to any organisation
sendToRecycling.confirmText: It goes straight to recycling. If no recycler accepts this category nearby, it goes to ReLoop's admin queue instead.

images.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Metadata such as GPS is stripped when uploaded.

candidates.title: Choose who gets the first offer
candidates.subtitle: Ranked by distance, declared need, urgency, storage space and reliability. Open a card to see why.
candidates.alreadyOffered: This donation has already been offered. This list is a preview only.

declines.one: 1 decline so far: the search has widened
declines.other: {count} declines so far: the search has widened

candidates.emptyTitle: No organisation in range right now
candidates.emptyText: Continuing will bring the decision back to you: you can redirect it to recycling or cancel.
candidates.howScored: Each score is a weighted sum of the factors shown. The weights are set by the platform for now; they will be calibrated once enough accept and decline history exists.

score.contributionHint: Points this factor adds, out of its weight

reason.noNeed: no declared need for this category
reason.noHistory: no offer history yet — neutral score

actions.reasonHint: Recorded in the donation's audit trail.

rematch.label: Re-match
rematch.confirm: Offer it to the next best organisation.

upgradePriority.label: Upgrade to priority
upgradePriority.confirm: Mark it as priority and offer it to the next best organisation. Priority donations rise in organisations' inboxes.

recycle.label: Send to recycling
recycle.confirm: Route it to the nearest recycling partner for this category. If none is in range, it goes to the admin queue.

chooseAcceptorCollection.label: They collect it
chooseAcceptorCollection.confirm: The organisation will arrange when to collect it.

dropoff.label: I'll drop it off
dropoff.confirm: Choose when you'll take it to the organisation.

handedOver.label: I've handed it over
handedOver.confirm: Confirm that the organisation now has your items.

cancel.label: Cancel donation
cancel.confirm: The donation is withdrawn (it is kept in your history). Any open offer is withdrawn too.

accept.label: Accept
accept.confirm: Accepting releases the donor's exact pickup address to you, and the release is recorded.

reject.label: Decline
reject.confirm: You won't be offered this donation again. It moves on to the next organisation.

confirmReceipt.label: Confirm receipt
confirmReceipt.confirm: Confirm you've received the items. This completes the donation.

requeue.label: Re-queue
requeue.confirm: Send it back into matching: it is offered to the next eligible organisation.

adminRecycle.confirm: Route it to the nearest recycling partner for this category.

confirmRecycled.label: Confirm recycled
confirmRecycled.confirm: Confirm on the recycler's behalf (simulated). A simulated settlement over estimated mass is recorded.

recycling.simulatedNote: Simulated: no money moves yet. Wallet credit arrives in a later phase.

booking.title: Platform pickup
booking.simulatedNote: Simulated: no real courier and no real payment gateway are involved.

pickup.title: Book a simulated courier
pickup.subtitle: ReLoop arranges and bills a simulated pickup from you and delivery to the organisation. You still hand the items over and they still confirm receipt.
pickup.distance: About {km} km from you to the organisation.
pickup.noProviders: No courier is available right now. Choose another handover option from the donation page.
pickup.whenHint: Any time in the future — the pickup window is only a preference.
pickup.walletHint: Up to {amount}, and never more than the cost. Optional — you can pay the full cost without it.
pickup.simulatedNote: SIMULATED: no real courier, and the checkout always succeeds.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.subtitle: Credited when a donation of yours is recycled. Spend it, in full or in part, on a platform-arranged pickup. No withdrawals.
wallet.emptyText: Recycle a donation that can't be reused, and your credit will appear here.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Updates on donations you're part of. Checked every {seconds} seconds while ReLoop is open.
notifications.emptyText: You'll see offers, answers and status changes here.

unreadCount.one: 1 unread. Open an item to mark it read.
unreadCount.other: {count} unread. Open an item to mark it read.

notify.STALL: {item} moved to the admin queue after no progress
notify.NO_RECYCLER: No recycler can take {item}; it's in the admin queue
notify.REQUEUE: {item} returned to matching by an admin
notify.BOOK_PICKUP: A platform pickup was booked for {item}

discover.title: Who's near you, and what they need
discover.subtitle: Every organisation here has been verified by ReLoop. Their requests are live: what they've asked for, and how urgently.
discover.approximate: Each circle shows the area an organisation is in, to within about {km} km. Exact addresses are shared only between a donor and an organisation, once a donation is accepted.
discover.emptyText: Try another category, or check back soon.
discover.noNeeds: No open requests right now — donations are still welcome.

verification.PENDING: An admin is reviewing your registration. You'll start receiving offers once you're verified; meanwhile, set up your needs list.
verification.VERIFIED: You're verified: donors near you can offer you what you need.
verification.REJECTED: Your registration wasn't approved, so you won't receive offers. Contact the platform team if you think this is a mistake.

acceptor.offersIntro: Most urgent first. You see a rounded distance until you accept; then the donor's address is released to you.
acceptor.noOffersText: When a donor near you lists something you need, it appears here. Keeping your needs list current helps you rank higher.
acceptor.noReceiving: Nothing in progress. Accepted donations appear here until you confirm receipt.

profile.title: Organisation profile
profile.subtitle: Keep these details current: matching reads them as soon as you save.
profile.lockedNote: Your name and registration ID are fixed after registration, so a verified organisation can't become a different one. Contact the platform team if they're wrong.
profile.acceptingNote: Donors are only matched with organisations that accept the category and have room for the items.
profile.locationNote: Drag the pin to your exact location: distance to donors is measured from it. The public map shows only your neighbourhood.
profile.savedText: Your profile is updated, and new rankings already use it.

offer.wherePrivacy: The donor's exact address is released to you when you accept, and that release is recorded. Until then you see only a rounded distance.

held.privacy: Visible to you while you hold this donation. Its release to you was recorded.
held.notHeldTitle: You no longer hold this donation
held.notHeldText: Its address is hidden again now that it has left your hands.
held.awaitingChoiceTitle: Waiting for the donor to choose
held.awaitingChoiceText: They can choose for you to collect it, drop it off themselves, or book a platform pickup. You'll see a schedule-pickup action here if they choose for you to collect it.

needs.title: What you need
needs.intro: Donations are ranked for you by these needs and their urgency.
needs.empty: No open needs. Add one so donors' items reach you first.

admin.title: Keep every donation moving
admin.intro: Donations wait here when no rule can move them on. Every action you take is recorded with your reason.
admin.allClearText: Every donation is moving on its own. Stalled ones appear here after the next sweep.

sweepSkipped.one: 1 donation was busy and skipped; the next sweep will catch it.
sweepSkipped.other: {count} donations were busy and skipped; the next sweep will catch them.

admin.redacted: Addresses are hidden in this list; opening a donation is recorded.
admin.recyclersNote: Recycling settlements are simulated: an admin confirms on the recycler's behalf and no money moves.
admin.noRecyclersText: Run the seed command to add the demo recyclers.
admin.recordedText: Opening this page shows you the donor's address, so the access was logged ({at}). It does not refresh by itself.
admin.holderNote: Shown to the donor while this organisation holds the donation.
admin.rankingRunsIntro: Each decision (an offer, or an escalation for want of candidates) stores the full slate it was made against, newest first. Open a row for its score breakdown.
admin.noRuns: No ranking runs yet: the donor hasn't made an offer.
admin.emptySlate: No eligible organisation: the donation escalated to the donor.
admin.verificationNoteHint: Shown on their dashboard, e.g. why a registration was rejected.
admin.verificationSaved: Saved. Only verified organisations receive offers.
admin.awaitingVerificationText: New organisations can't receive offers until an admin verifies them. Filter by status to review them.
admin.commissionNote: Simulated: earnings from logistics fees and recycling fees. A cancelled, undelivered booking's commission is reversed, so the total is always net.

chat.title: Conversation
chat.empty: No messages yet. Say hello and agree on the handover.
chat.closedGeneric: You can read it, but no longer reply.
chat.messageHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line. Messages can't be edited or deleted.
chat.threadsNote: This donation was accepted more than once. Earlier conversations are read-only.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: That address doesn't lead anywhere in ReLoop.

ChatClosure.NO_LONGER_HELD: The organisation no longer holds this donation, so the conversation is read-only.

DonationAction.CHOOSE_ACCEPTOR_COLLECTION: Chose for the organisation to collect

EscalationCause.THRESHOLD_REACHED: Several organisations in a row declined it.
EscalationCause.NO_CANDIDATES: No eligible organisation is in range right now.
EscalationCause.NOT_OFFERED: It was listed for a while without being offered.
